mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 10.0% signals severe labor market distress that typically precedes earnings declines and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0, or signal Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% monthly growth in consumer credit (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST growth > 0.5% monthly fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 40% of cases, or interaction Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary conditions (GDPC1 growth < 0.0%), industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals worsening supply conditions that typically cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 0.0 and INDPRO < 95.0, or signal Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals strong residential construction activity, typically producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth > 0.5% fails to correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns in > 40% of cases, or signal Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: 12-month CPIAUCSL inflation change exceeding 3.0% signals heightened inflation concerns that typically prompt monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0, or signal Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls growth exceeding 0.2% monthly combined with FEDFUNDS below 0.5% indicates strong labor market conditions and accommodative policy, typically driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength and monetary ease
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 40% of cases, or interaction Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, typically causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or signal Rank IC is below 0.01.
